text.text: Rebuild your Mart to earn rewards and increase its <color=#C2FF47>Max Income<color=white>. The mart needs to be <color=#FFFF77>100% Completed.
Reset your Mart to earn rewards and increase its <color=#C2FF47>Max Income<color=white>. The mart needs to be least <color=#FFFF77>80% Completed.
Congratulations, your current Mart is now <color=#FFFF77>100% Completed<color=white>. You can now visit the Map to prestige your Mart.
Visit the Map to prestige your Mart and earn more Goldbars.
